dan.support: FYI - triaging 3 customer tickets that look like the same ask: better streaming support for tool/function calls + structured outputs on chat/completions. customers: AcmeCorp, SentiAI, BeaconHealth. short notes below, want product input on scope/prio.
ops-bot: Tickets linked: <https://tickets.redwood/acme-321|ACME-321>, <https://tickets.redwood/senti-887|SENTI-887>, <https://tickets.redwood/beacon-44|BEACON-44> :incoming_envelope:
laura.pm: Thanks. Quick summary of asks? what exact behavior are they expecting from streaming vs current streaming?
mike.eng: Current streaming sends incremental chunks of text only. Customers want tooling around function/tool calls to stream the call boundary + structured output schema events, e.g.:
```
data: {"type":"tool_call_start","name":"lookup_user","id":"c1"}
data: {"type":"tool_call_chunk","id":"c1","payload":"{\"user_id\":\"123\"}"}
data: {"type":"tool_call_end","id":"c1","status":200}
```
Also want a way to emit final structured output (JSON) as a typed event rather than forcing them to parse raw tokens.
jena.product: Product question: do we make this a new streaming contract (v2) or extend current events? v2 is cleaner but heavier for SDKs.
laura.pm: Launch criteria thoughts: must have backward compatibility (old streams still work), SDK helpers for Node/Python, docs + sample app, perf tests that show <10% median latency regression, and a beta customer rollout path.
dan.support: Customers are asking for an opt-in flag now (they already have workarounds). Acme wants GA in ~8 weeks, Senti is flexible, Beacon is regulatory and needs stability.
mike.eng: Engineering notes: implementing event envelope is straightforward in the stream layer. Hard bits: function call KV cache interaction, batching semantics, and ensuring streaming ordering with async tool exec. Estimate 3 sprints for a small team (2 SWE + 1 infra). Impact on autoscaler: more long-lived connections -> different concurrency model.
jena.product: Proposed scope (MVP): 1) event envelope for streaming tool calls (start/chunk/end) 2) single optional "structured_output" event with schema URL + checksum 3) opt-in via request param `streaming_tool_events=true` 4) SDK helpers to decode events. Defer streaming function-of-functions and multiplexed tool sessions to future.
laura.pm: Risk checks: security (mixed-origin tool payloads), telemetry (need new spans/traces), billing clarity (how do we count tokens in streamed chunks vs final structured blob). Also needs test harness for playback.
dan.support: Can we add a simple acceptance test for customers: send a sample request -> assert you get `tool_call_start` then `tool_call_end` and a structured output event? If yes, we can run this with the three customers during beta.
mike.eng: Yes, will add an end-to-end test in the stream test harness. Also will add a perf sim for sustained N connections with long-lived streams.
jena.product: Prioritization ask: is this Q2 high priority or Q3? given GA ask from Acme, propose we mark as P1 for next triage and allocate a canary sprint.
laura.pm: agree P1 for product backlog. Next steps: 1) eng to draft API contract + sample stream events (mike) 2) SDks to plan helpers (devex) 3) support to schedule beta customers (dan) 4) security review (security team) 5) doc + sample app (jena).
dan.support: I'll open a consolidation ticket summarizing the three customer asks and link to this thread. tagging @laura.pm and @mike.eng for visibility. :+1:
ops-bot: Created ticket CONSOL-1729 and linked to ACME-321, SENTI-887, BEACON-44
laura.pm: timeline suggestion: start spec this week, eng spike next week, aim for beta in 4-6 weeks, GA in 8-10 if no major blockers.
mike.eng: will post a draft contract in #eng-runtime by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:
